title: symplocos pulchra subsp. villosa
intro: Symplocos pulchra subsp. villosa, commonly known as the Symplocos villosa, is a species of flowering plant in the family Symplocaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the tropical regions of Asia, and is valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant is known to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Symplocos pulchra subsp. villosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects.
